Definition: from G3956 and G5056; full-ended, i.e. entire (neuter as noun, completion):--+ in (no) wise, uttermost.
BiblicalUsage: Pantelēs means completely, to the uttermost, entirely. Christ is able to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by Him, seeing He ever liveth to make intercession for them, and in Luke a woman is bowed together and can in no wise lift up herself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe to the uttermost is the measure of Christ's saving: He does not save halfway, and He lives forever to keep interceding for those He saves.
